scope: Uses the current full website source and preserves its existing routes, products, sample websites, documentation, legal pages and PWA behaviour.
Uses the supplied full-body transparent DVNM art with hands, arms, legs and the luminous chest wordmark; adds a separate head layer for subtle head turning and nodding.
Adds a cyan face display with speech-boundary mouth pulses when browser events are available and a CSS fallback otherwise.
Enables voice selection when the browser exposes speech voices and persists the chosen voice; speaking remains explicitly user initiated.
Restores the earlier site midnight palette with readable transparent glass surfaces, and a seven-step pale mint/gray/beige/violet/indigo/rose section rhythm.
Keeps the floating robot above WhatsApp on narrow screens and constrains panel widths and heights for safe-area-aware mobile layouts.
Adds a maintained documentation guide on bot motion, voice, theme, accessibility, and device limitations.
image_generation: No new raster image generated; robot parts are alpha-masked derivatives of the existing supplied webp artwork and demo illustrations are hand-authored SVG.
manual_visual_test: Not completed: browser navigation to local files/localhost is blocked by this execution environment. Review visually on actual phone/tablet/desktop after deployment.

asset_summary.robot_art: Supplied transparent full-body DVNM cutout, alpha-masked body/head layers, face overlay, and speech-reactive chest aura
asset_summary.demo_detail_card_navigator: Removed from detail pages; index only
asset_summary.service_worker: v32 cache name with V32 CSS and body/head layers pre-cached

robot.implementation: Layered full-body supplied artwork with separately masked head; CSS face overlay; speech and click response controlled by existing site JavaScript.
robot.appearance: Silver-blue full-body robot with visible arms, hands, legs and DVNM chest; original image provides the character surface.
movement: gentle walking-like body bob while speaking
robot.speech: Browser/device SpeechSynthesis; user may choose an available device voice. Default Recommended DVNM Voice selects an appropriate English voice where available. Word boundary callbacks drive mouth pulses; CSS fallback used when they are missing.
robot.limitations: This is a lightweight 2D image rig, not a true 3D physics model. The head has a separate layer; arms and legs remain in the supplied full-body layer and do not perform independent skeletal walking. Speech animation is word-timed, not phoneme-perfect. Browser voice quality is device-dependent.

demo_page_behavior: The seven illustrated cards appear on demos/index.html only; each detail page is a focused demonstration with one unique hero SVG.
theme_update: v31 restores the older Davonium midnight base with violet/cyan/green glows and more translucent glass surfaces. The light theme retains a soft white/mint/lilac/sand/mist-grey rhythm; reduced-motion preferences remain respected.

bot.implementation: Unified CSS-built robot with connected joint geometry. Homepage no longer layers the smiling cut-out image over the CSS robot.
bot.appearance: Neutral open cyan lens eyes, compact straight mouth, silver/blue body, antenna and readable DVNM chest plate.
bot.speech_animation: Speaking state activates the mouth, gentle arm gestures and a brighter multicolour glow around the DVNM chest badge.
bot.voice: Browser/device Speech Synthesis, default output volume 72%, smaller text chunks, default-voice retry and stall recovery.
bot.honesty_note: Voice availability and voice quality still depend on the visitor device/browser. CSS movement approximates speech activity and is not phoneme-perfect lip sync; deployment needs live visual/device testing.
